asr.full_text: Hi guys, welcome back for another session with MalithAffijal. I will start by saying Wishing you a Happy New Year for 2019. In this video I will show how to use Office deployment tool for Office 365. and some tips and tricks. Because most of the IT people face problem is in Office deployment tool is Confirming the configuration file. The people who are familiar with editing XML codes have no issues. But other face major problem and waste minute or hours of searching to configure it. So I will open both in new tabs And you can see in the Overview which shows how to deploy the development tools For the development tools you will need the following two tools The first tool is called is the Open Source Search Tutorial And the second tool is called is Open Open So you can see there are three types of and you can see in the Overview it shows how to use this product and here you can download and edit the configuration file. So some of the people who doesn't understand coding, it's little bit hard for them to know how to configure it. But whether you are a professional developer or a normal IT person who has background in networking and Windows configuration, it'll be easier for them to configure. So I'll start downloading it. I'll download the file and I'll save it on my Desktop. After its downloaded... I'll save it on my desktop so after it's downloaded I'll minimize this document and I'll drag it and drop it on here. You can use any browser for this so after accepting all the necessary requirements after reading the document properly we will continue and we will be saving it on my desktop itself so I'll be creating folder called Office deployment tools and I'll extract all the needed setup to that folder and you can see the configuration files for 64-bit 32-bit as well as the setup file so now I tell you what is the short or the tips and tricks version of configuring the office file, that is provided by Microsoft Office itself called config.office.com. When you visit this website, You have an interface to configure the office document. Sorry but I mean the configuration file. As you can see the interface is is user friendly so anyone can understand how to configure. So what I have is, I will go from the product and release, select 64 bit, and I will select Office 365 pro plus. If you want VCO or project needed to be added to this system, as your license available for your company you can select if you want different language pack as well you can get the product and the update channel whether you get the latest version to be displayed all else how to be updated monthly annually or semiannually so the next step is selecting the language after this ... We look at language and the Global language... Everybody who uses the language is English So I'll be selecting the language English OK.....Over here and ... If necessary you can select the secondary language So we will go to the Install option I'll keep as the default is Or you can save save local network path and configuration manager shows do you want to see installation pin the icons to the task bar login systems save lock file to network place and when you click next it shows the update and upgrade option log file to a Net workplace and when you click next it shows the update and upgrade option Office content, Network and Automatic updates however the version should be done and if this is the operation it'll uninstall the previous version and install if you won't select the top file and if you want to select to the .cm language then you have to click that and click Next. Then you will be prompted whether you need the KMS key system more activation. It differs from package to package and whether there are other settings and so when you click the next one then you have organization name and staff so I own an tech learning and solution it's one of the training companies in Sri Lanka so I'll provide the name over here and remember I show you this because you cannot use any symbols if your company name has some please provide without the symbols that means any other symbol so you can provide a description I will provide here by saying this the latest installation of the office package you can put whatever you want some companies provide description what is to me needed to be this place so if the application process you can put your share point details and other stuff what is needed outlook configurations and everything what are the files need to be saved so after configuring all the details you can see on the right side of you when I click finish you can see what all the configurations has been selected by me to develop the configuration file. So after that you can export the file excepting the terms and conditions I will export the file. Let me save it on my computer and I will create a folder inside the Office deployment folder what I created on my desktop by saying see configuration file so it will be easy for us to see and this is my configuration file which is created through the system and I'll open the default configuration file. so when side by side , you can see that in right side it has the total details Sometime you cannot understand sometimes you can So If you already have configuration file you can import that file We will import the file let say X86 and here you can see the configuration What is available. The right side shows what the configuration is done. So if you want to change anything in that. You can change it. So here are the things what are available. So as it is, you can import and edit the same file & enter a new one so these are the thing available If you want to change anything, that's it After doing all these, you can remove all the save in location and now, the new configuration file. So that's it guys if you have any question regarding this. And I put all the link down below for this video. Thank you. Thanks for watching, please subscribe to my youtube channel and press the bell for future videos.
